about: The hook on each page a reader is sent to (ADR-132, A hook on every page): one entry a page, what its first screen says before anything else. The React build reads this file for the landing, a blog post, the Quality page and the review route; the API reads it for /about and the resume door. Every line is copied word for word from the source it names, and a count is never typed here: {recommendations} is read from data/recommendations.json when the page is drawn.
